name: Open Cases by Type and Reason
query:
SELECT
    i.issue_type,
    i.case_record_type AS "Case Record Type",
    COUNT(i.case_reason) AS 'Case Reason Count',
    i.created_date AS 'Opened Date',
    u.full_name AS "Case Owner",
    i.case_owner as "email", 
    COUNT(*) AS "Closed Issue",
    i.case_origin AS "Case Origin",
    i.case_number AS "Case Number"
FROM
    `tabIssue` i
JOIN
    `tabUser` u ON i.case_owner = u.email
WHERE
    i.status = 'Open'
GROUP BY
    i.issue_type;
report_name: Open Cases by Type and Reason
